mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.seller_id AS sellerId, u.username AS sellerUsername, b.title, b.author, b.publisher, b.isbn, b.category_id AS categoryId, b.category_path AS categoryPath, b.price, b.original_price AS originalPrice, b.book_condition AS bookCondition, b.description, b.defect_desc AS defectDesc, b.cover_image AS coverImageStr, b.status, b.is_banned AS isBanned, b.view_count AS viewCount, b.trade_type AS tradeType, b.publish_time AS publishTime, b.sold_at AS soldAt, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM book b LEFT JOIN user u ON b.seller_id = u.id WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.is_banned = 0
